x: The 5th man was about 30 yards behind them, and 100 yards further back a like tussle for the 6th place was being waged between another R.A.F. man and H.

A Club handicap, for which prizes were given by Jack Wakeley, was won by H. Jeffery, also doing his first Brighton with an allowance of 1 hour 40 minutes, with Hugh McGreechan, allowance 1 hour, second.
We were pleased to see Dick Frazer among the prize winners after his gallant effort in the “ Brighton ” and H. Jeffery’ who also performed so well in that race.

Track Champion, Vic Stone, in the time of 55 mins. 43 secs., with Eric Hall 3rd and Fred Rolfe 16th. A fortnight later Beecham and Hall were again 2nd and 3rd in the Surrey W.C. race at Tooting Bec with H.
